items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Well, it was, uh, Lopez on trumpet, Gus Miller on clarinet, Tommy Brown on trombone, I was playing piano, and Bill Lambert on drums.

ctx.x: This was an attraction. Not with her act.

No, no. No, no. No, she had two good bookings to fool around with us. She, she didn't want anything like that. Uh, she was a, she was a big, big, big, big Vortigil star. Mm-hmm. She was appearing here. But, uh, she was instrumental through her manager, Gorham, getting us up to Chicago. Mm-hmm. And when we went to Chicago, we... Wait a minute, now, who, who was the whole band? Well, it was, uh, Lopez on trumpet, Gus Miller on clarinet, Tommy Brown on trombone, I was playing piano, and Bill Lambert on drums.…
Uh-huh. Well, now, uh, was, it went under the name of Brown's Band?
